7139.title: India S&T Scoreboard: integrated State/UT benchmarking
7139.overview: NITI Aayog launched the India S&T Scoreboard on 3 November 2026. It provides an integrated view of the science-and-technology landscape across Indian States and Union Territories.
7139.context: Research and innovation data had been fragmented across sources. The scoreboard brings ecosystem and scientific-output data together to support evidence-based policymaking and cooperative and competitive federalism.
7139.who: NITI Aayog launched the platform in New Delhi. The official release identifies the scoreboard as a NITI Aayog initiative, with State/UT benchmarking as a key purpose.
7139.what: It combines ecosystem data—higher-education institutions, R&D institutions, deep-tech startups and incubators—with outputs such as research publications and patents. It also presents research-quality, impact, collaboration and open-access indicators across Academia, Government R&D Labs and Industry.
7139.why: States need comparable, accessible evidence to identify strengths and gaps, learn from one another and design more effective science-and-technology programmes.
7139.significance: The platform supports state-level planning, institutional capacity-building and a broader view of innovation than publication or patent volume alone.
7139.exam: Remember the three sectors: Academia, Government R&D Labs and Industry. NITI Aayog is the nodal body. The scoreboard is not a DST-only or Ministry of Earth Sciences initiative, and it is not limited to counting publications.
7139.source: Press Information Bureau, Government of India; NITI Aayog dashboard

7142.title: COP31 in Antalya and the COP30 roadmaps
7142.overview: COP31 is scheduled to begin in Antalya, Türkiye, on 9 November 2026. Reuters reported that Brazil's COP30 fossil-fuel and forest roadmaps had not secured consensus.
7142.context: The UN climate conference process operates under the UNFCCC.
7142.who: Brazil led COP30 in Belém; Türkiye hosts COP31 in Antalya.
7142.what: The proposed roadmaps sought to accelerate the shift from fossil fuels and strengthen forest finance but were not adopted by consensus.
7142.why: The story illustrates the gap between climate pledges, finance, negotiation and implementation.
7142.significance: COP31 = Antalya, Türkiye. Do not describe COP30 proposals as binding decisions.
